channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Pacquiao, Mayweather announce September rematch in Vegas
item.description: Floyd Mayweather Jr. vs. Manny Pacquiao made boxing history in 2015. More than a decade later, the two legends are hoping to do it again.

item.title: No-shows by Trump’s envoy to France increase diplomatic friction
item.description: PARIS >> Charles Kushner shows no interest in learning French, pays little heed to the strict codes of Parisian bureaucracy and causes consternation in the nation that shaped modern diplomacy.

item.title: Mexico weighs legal action after Musk links president to drug cartels
item.description: MEXICO CITY >> Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said today she is considering legal action following a comment by tech billionaire Elon Musk, the world’s richest man, that alleged she was connected to drug cartels.

item.title: Yen weakens on report Japan prime minister questioned rate hike plans
item.description: NEW YORK >> The yen slipped today after a news report that Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi had conveyed her reservations about further interest rate hikes to Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda, raising doubts over the next rate increase. The report, if true, signals potential friction over monetary policy that could complicate the BOJ’s timetable as coordination with the newly strengthened administration becomes more delicate.

item.title: High surf advisory covers most north, east shores
Head-on collision in Hauula sends 4 to the hospital
item.description: A head-on collision on Kamehameha Highway in Hauula this morning sent four adults to the hospital, according to first responders.

item.title: Democrat says DOJ withheld Epstein files on Trump abuse claim
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The Department of Justice appears to have withheld from disclosed files on disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein documents related to a claim that President Donald Trump sexually abused a minor, a top Democratic lawmaker said today.

item.title: Anthropic digs in heels in AI dispute with Pentagon, source says
item.description: Artificial intelligence lab Anthropic has no intention of easing its usage restrictions for military purposes, a person familiar with the matter said today, adding talks continue after a meeting to discuss its future with the Pentagon.

item.title: Trump touts economic policies in record-setting State of the Union
item.description: WASHINGTON >> President Donald Trump touted his economic record during the longest State of the Union address in history today, boasting that he had ushered in a “golden age” as he sought to project an aura of success at a fraught moment for his presidency.

item.title: Woman, 82, critically injured after being pinned beneath SUV in Manoa
item.description: An 82-year-old woman is in critical condition after she was run over by a car in Manoa this morning, according to first responders.
